html:
Question 11
?

Find and categorize all the local extrema of the function f(x,y) given that f′(x,y)=[ex(x2+2x−y2)−2yex].

a
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (0,0) and a local maximum at (−2,0)
b
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (−1,0) and a saddle point at (1,0)
c
f(x,y) has saddles points at (0,0) and (−2,0)
d
f(x,y) has a saddle point at (0,0) and a local maximum at (−2,0)
e
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (−1,0) and a local maximum at (1,0)
